sources.title: Aion Labs models API: aion-labs/aion-rp-llama-3.1-8b
sources.evidence: Exact API identifier has date 2024-11-30, name AionLabs: Aion-RP 1.0 (8B), context_length 32768, text-to-text modality, reasoning false, tool_calls false, and reasoning_effort.supported false. Described as a Llama 3.1 8B variant for roleplaying and storytelling. Read through web browser tool; a separate Python HTTP request returned 403. Reopened on 2026-10-27: the exact endpoint still calls this Aion-RP 1.0 (8B), explicitly a Llama 3.1 8B variant, and provides no active-parameter count or counting convention.

sources.title: Models — Aion Labs Docs
sources.evidence: Developer documentation independently displays the exact model ID, roleplaying purpose, 32K served context and explicit Released: 2024-11-30. Reopened on 2026-10-27: the exact model row retains its explicit 8B name and Llama 3.1 8B lineage; no separately defined active count is published.

sources.title: Aion-RP-Llama-3.1-8B model card at 8ae617bc
sources.evidence: Developer-owned card names meta-llama/Llama-3.1-8B as base model, declares apache-2.0 metadata, describes roleplaying and creative-writing training, claims full 131K context and documents a custom text conversation format. Immutable raw source successfully fetched. Reopened the pinned card and current main on 2026-10-27: the base-model declaration remains unchanged and no active-count definition is present.

sources.title: Aion-RP-Llama-3.1-8B configuration at 8ae617bc
sources.evidence: Exact fine-tune configuration specifies LlamaForCausalLM, 32 layers, hidden size 4096, intermediate size 14336, 32 attention heads, eight KV heads, untied embeddings, vocabulary 128256 and max_position_embeddings 131072. Standard dense Llama components, not an expert-routing configuration. Reopened on 2026-10-27: the same dense dimensions remain; no expert expansion, pruning configuration, new modality or active-parameter counting convention is disclosed.

sources.title: Aion-RP-Llama-3.1-8B weight index at 8ae617bc
sources.evidence: Public index lists seven weight shards and 291 tensors comprising embeddings, language-model head, normalization and dense attention/MLP projections. Total F32 tensor size 32,121,044,992 bytes corresponds to 8,030,261,248 parameters and matches the count derived from its config. Reopened the index on 2026-10-27 without downloading shards: it still records 32,121,044,992 bytes, 291 tensors and seven shards.

sources.title: Hugging Face repository metadata for the exact Aion fine-tune
sources.publisher: Hugging Face; model repository owned by Aion Labs
sources.evidence: Reports current revision 8ae617bc85c5d6698c3323863c42098d1998f7bb, 8,030,261,248 F32 safetensors parameters, creation 2024-11-09 and last modification 2024-11-30. Creation time is not treated as a confirmed public release date. Fresh metadata fetch on 2026-10-27 confirms the same revision and lastModified 2024-11-30T05:34:44.000Z, with safetensors.total and F32 parameter count both 8,030,261,248. No newer checkpoint is indicated.

sources.title: Llama 3.1 Community License Agreement
sources.evidence: The explicitly identified base model uses the Llama 3.1 Community License, whose redistribution provisions cover derivatives. This leaves an unresolved qualification to the fine-tune card declaring only Apache-2.0; no separate license document appears in the fine-tune repository.

sources.title: Meta Llama 3.1 official model card — parameter convention recheck
sources.evidence: Accessed on 2026-10-27, including the raw GitHub source. The Params table specifies the text-only Llama 3.1 base as nominal 8B and describes an autoregressive transformer with grouped-query attention. It does not separately specify active parameters or a convention mapping dense total parameters to an active count. Targeted searches of Aion and Meta primary sources found no additional active-count disclosure for this fine-tune.

name.note: Matches official display name after omitting the provider prefix.

developer.note: The publisher of this fine-tune is Aion Labs; Meta developed the stated base model.

family.note: Fine-tune card explicitly identifies the Llama 3.1 8B base, and its own config retains LlamaForCausalLM.

release_date.note: Explicit developer-reported release date supersedes baseline 2025-02-04. Repository creation is earlier (2024-11-09), so this is not a claim that no weights existed before November 30.

open_weights.note: Exact fine-tune publishes seven safetensors weight shards. This confirms availability, not a permissive-license conclusion.

license.note: Fine-tune card declares Apache-2.0, but the expressly identified base carries the Llama 3.1 Community License with derivative redistribution provisions. Retain null pending clarification rather than presenting Apache-2.0 as the complete governing license.

parameters_b.note: Retain the developer-published nominal 8B specification: Aion names the exact endpoint 8B and explicitly identifies it as a Llama 3.1 8B variant; its model card names that base. The unchanged dense config shows no disclosed structural change defeating this lineage. Fresh repository metadata also confirms 8,030,261,248 published checkpoint parameters. The nominal specification is supported independently of that exact count.

active_parameters_b.note: Freshly reopened Aion API/docs, fine-tune card/config and Meta base-model card disclose no separate per-token active count or applicable counting convention; targeted searches found no newer first-party disclosure. Dense architecture alone does not justify copying the nominal 8B total or exact checkpoint tensor total into this field.

architecture.note: Exact fine-tune artifacts implement a dense decoder-only Llama causal transformer with grouped-query attention and dense MLP projections; no MoE routing or expert tensor groups are present.

context_window.note: Retain the exact API endpoint limit of 32768. Separately, downloadable weights declare and configure 131072 positions. The deployment limit is not the weight architecture limit.

modalities.note: Exact Aion endpoint explicitly reports text-to-text; the fine-tune card supplies a text conversation template.

reasoning.note: Exact endpoint reports reasoning false and reasoning-effort support false. This concerns dedicated reasoning support, not an assertion that the model cannot solve reasoning tasks.

tool_call.note: Exact endpoint reports tool_calls false; no tool support is inherited merely because other Llama variants provide it.

description.value: Llama 3.1 8B fine-tune for roleplaying and creative writing.
description.note: Replace generic instruction-model, multilingual, reasoning and coding claims with the purpose documented for this exact fine-tune.

patch.description: Llama 3.1 8B fine-tune for roleplaying and creative writing.
patch.notes: Nominal 8B is developer-published and supported by explicit Llama 3.1 8B lineage; repository metadata reports 8,030,261,248 checkpoint parameters. Active parameters are not separately specified. API context is 32,768 tokens; the downloadable fine-tune config supports 131,072 positions. Developer reports release on 2024-11-30, while the repository was created on 2024-11-09. Fine-tune metadata declares Apache-2.0, but its Llama 3.1 base has a separate community license; the complete licensing position is unresolved.

summary: Parameter re-audit on 2026-10-27 confirms developer-published nominal 8B and the unchanged 8,030,261,248-parameter checkpoint. Aion explicitly identifies the Llama 3.1 8B base; the dense config shows no structural change invalidating that basis. Reopened Aion API/docs, fine-tune artifacts and Meta model card, plus targeted searches, reveal no separately published active count or applicable counting convention: active_parameters_b remains null/undisclosed. Preserve all other prior assessments, including the API-versus-checkpoint context distinction and unresolved licensing qualification.
